stock.description: Operating as an investment holding company, Hybrid Kinetic Group Limited focuses on the development and sale of electric vehicles, battery management systems, spare parts, and advanced battery materials across the People's Republic of China. The company also provides financial leasing solutions. Incorporated in 1995, the firm changed its name from Far East Golden Resources Group Limited to Hybrid Kinetic Group Limited in March 2010, and it is based in Central, Hong Kong.
